name: fred_real_gdp_per_capita
description:
The US real GDP per capita from FRED, the St. Louis Fed's economic database: series A939RX0Q048SBEA (chained dollars, quarterly).
Returns {"series": "A939RX0Q048SBEA", "data": <FRED observations response>}; data.observations = [{date (YYYY-MM-DD), value (a string, "." if missing), realtime_start, realtime_end}], newest first; data is {"error": ...} if the call fails.
Inputs (* required): series_id (string; default A939RX0Q048SBEA, this tool's series), limit (integer, number of newest observations; default 20).
Related: fred_gdp, fred_gdp_growth.
Example: {"series_id": "A939RX0Q048SBEA", "limit": 20}

series_id.description: FRED series id; defaults to this tool's series

limit.description: Number of most recent observations to return (newest first)
